verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a durable-execution platform with cloud and admin APIs, so the axis applies. The pack only shows adjacent security features: request identity, which verifies that requests come from a Restate instance, and access restriction so only Restate calls services. It also mentions per-scope concurrency limits, which are traffic shaping, not credential scoping. Nothing documents issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
